intervalSeconds.help: How long each prayer or reflection stays on screen.

textScale.help: Adjusts quote size while still fitting inside the screen.

textOpacity.help: Controls how strongly the quote appears over the background.

showMetadata.help: Shows the optional title and source from quotes.json.

dataSource.help: Choose bundled quotes.json or a remote prayers endpoint.

remoteEndpoint.help: Endpoint returning either an array of prayers or {"prayers": [...]}.

remoteRefreshMinutes.help: How often to reload the remote endpoint. Use 0 to disable automatic refresh.

fallbackToLocal.help: If the remote endpoint fails, use bundled quotes.json instead of showing an error.

backgroundMotion.help: Controls how quickly the background spectrum drifts.

paletteIntensity.help: Controls the strength of the muted color spectrum.

backgroundBrightness.help: Lower values keep the wallpaper darker.

particleDensity.help: Controls the number of quiet light particles in the background.

particleGlow.help: Controls how softly the particles illuminate the background.

enableAnimation.help: Turns background and text motion on or off.
